description:
PLAN.md describes an extension trait `JmapCalendarsExt` whose methods ARE the calendar operations (`async fn calendar_get` directly on the trait). The shipped design instead exposes a single trait method `with_calendars_session` that returns a `SessionClient`, and all 19 calendar methods are inherent methods on `SessionClient`.

Other discrepancies:
- PLAN.md uses `&Id` and `&State`; impl uses `&str`.
- PLAN.md has `SetRequest<T>` / `CopyRequest<T>` / `CalendarEventQueryRequest` builder structs; impl uses raw `serde_json::Value` for filter/sort/create/update/destroy.
- PLAN.md has `CalendarEventGetArgs` with String fields; impl has `CalendarEventGetParams` with bool fields and a different name.
- PLAN.md lists 18 methods but README and impl ship 19 (parse + availability added later).

Not a correctness bug — but PLAN.md is the canonical design doc per workspace AGENTS.md, and reviewers / future-Mark will read it expecting it to match. Either rewrite PLAN.md to describe the shipped design, or delete it.
title: PLAN.md describes a different API than the one shipped
